title: zxdb-cli Protocol Schema
description: JSON schema for requests and responses in the zxdb-cli UDS protocol

AsyncBacktraceRequest.description: Request asynchronous backtrace (async task tree) for a process.
AsyncBacktraceRequest.title: AsyncBacktraceRequest

AttachRequest.description: Request to attach to a process.
AttachRequest.title: AttachRequest

BreakRequest.description:
Request to set or delete a breakpoint at a file and line.

The file path must be fully qualified from the workspace root, an absolute
path, or exist relative to the current working directory.
To delete a breakpoint, set delete=True and ensure the file and line match
an existing breakpoint.
To view currently installed breakpoints, use the get-state command.
BreakRequest.title: BreakRequest

ContinueRequest.description: Request to resume execution of a thread.
ContinueRequest.title: ContinueRequest

DetachRequest.description: Request to detach from a process.
DetachRequest.title: DetachRequest

EvaluateRequest.description: Request evaluation of an expression in a given stack frame.
EvaluateRequest.title: EvaluateRequest

FinishRequest.description: Request to finish execution of current frame (step out).
FinishRequest.title: FinishRequest

HelloRequest.description: Initial handshake request to verify protocol version.
HelloRequest.title: HelloRequest

NextRequest.description: Request to step over to the next line of code.
NextRequest.title: NextRequest

PauseRequest.description: Request to pause execution of a thread or process.
PauseRequest.title: PauseRequest

StackTraceRequest.description: Request stack trace for a thread or all threads in a process.
StackTraceRequest.title: StackTraceRequest

StartRequest.description: Request to start the debugging session.
StartRequest.title: StartRequest

StepInRequest.description: Request to step into a function call.
StepInRequest.title: StepInRequest

StopRequest.description: Request to stop the daemon and session.
StopRequest.title: StopRequest

VariablesRequest.description: Request variables for a frame in a thread.
VariablesRequest.title: VariablesRequest

WaitForEventRequest.description: Request to wait for a debug adapter event.
WaitForEventRequest.title: WaitForEventRequest

WatchRequest.description:
Request to set or delete a data breakpoint (watchpoint) on a variable,
expression, or memory address.

`name` is the variable or expression to watch when setting a watchpoint,
or the `data_id` of the watchpoint to remove when `delete=True`. Active
watchpoints, including both their `data_id` and `expression`, are listed
in `get-state`.

When setting a watchpoint, `thread_id` and `access_type` are required
(`frame_index` is optional, defaulting to 0) to identify the target process
and stack frame for evaluation. If the thread is running, the daemon
automatically pauses it first.

To watch a memory address, pass a dereferenced pointer expression
(e.g., `*(uint32_t*)0x1234`).
To clear all active watchpoints, set `clear=True`.
WatchRequest.title: WatchRequest

AsyncBacktraceResponse.description: Response containing async tasks for a process.
AsyncBacktraceResponse.title: AsyncBacktraceResponse

AsyncTaskNode.description: Represents a node in the async task tree.
AsyncTaskNode.title: AsyncTaskNode

EvaluateResponse.description: Unified response containing the evaluation result and optional children.
EvaluateResponse.title: EvaluateResponse

GetStateResponse.description:
Response for get-state command containing thread list, active
processes, and active breakpoints.
GetStateResponse.title: GetStateResponse

ProcessStackTraceResponse.description: Response containing stack traces for all threads in a process.
ProcessStackTraceResponse.title: ProcessStackTraceResponse

Source.description:
A Source is a descriptor for source code.

Attributes:
    name: The short name of the source.
    path: The path of the source to be shown in the UI.
    source_reference: If the value > 0 the contents of the source must be
        retrieved through the `source` request.
    origin: The origin of this source (e.g., 'internal module', 'inlined
        content from source map').
Source.title: Source

StackFrame.description: A stack frame representation exposing frame_index instead of DAP frameId.
StackFrame.title: StackFrame

ThreadStackTraceResponse.description: Stack trace for a single thread in a process.
ThreadStackTraceResponse.title: ThreadStackTraceResponse

WatchpointInfo.description:
Information about an active data breakpoint (watchpoint).

`verified` and `message` reflect the latest status reported by zxdb, either
from the `setDataBreakpoints` response or from a later asynchronous
`breakpoint` "changed" event.
WatchpointInfo.title: WatchpointInfo
